meta.geography_note: The subject property's address is withheld under the privacy rule (see docs/PRIVACY.md). Every figure here is therefore a CONTAINER figure - county, city or MSA - and is labelled as such. None of it is a trade-area figure for the parcel. W-01 is consequently 'addressed-gated', not complete.

label_key.observation: A number printed by the official source. Quoted as-is.
label_key.derived: Arithmetic performed on observations from one or more official sources; the formula is shown.
label_key.unverified: No official value obtained. The value field is left empty on purpose.

labour_market.label: observation

labour_market.label: derived

labour_market.note: Six years to recover 1.3 percentage points of job count. This is the single strongest quantitative argument that the region has not had a growth cycle, only a recovery.

labour_market.label: derived
labour_market.series: MSA total nonfarm employment versus October 2024
labour_market.note: Two years of essentially flat job count.

industry_mix.label: observation

industry_mix.label: observation
industry_mix.read_through: Flat. The logistics/warehouse engine that drove Inland Empire growth has stalled at the county line.

industry_mix.label: observation
industry_mix.read_through: White-collar office demand, which sets the lunchtime density of a Central LA corridor, is barely growing.

industry_mix.label: observation
industry_mix.read_through: Media/tech contraction. Negative for high-income daytime footfall.

industry_mix.label: observation
industry_mix.read_through: No construction boom. Matters for redevelopment/exit value of the land under the box.

tenant_health.note: Verbatim from the filing: 'which includes a block closure program and selling real estate'. The tenant has publicly named real-estate disposition as a lever. An owner planning to sell into that same window is competing with the tenant's own supply.
